payload.reason: The evidence provides specific sources from which the data was gathered, including various literary, conversational, and journalistic texts.

claims.text: The data sources included varied text from conversational, literary, and religious sources, as well as news magazines and a book of proverbs.
The Global Voices corpus, which consists of journalistic news text from a multilingual community, was selected as a test set.
The dataset was significantly expanded from a majority Biblical text corpus to millions of tokens from over a dozen sources.
